zh.title: 西捷航空回應空服員罷工通知 發出72小時封鎖通知
zh.summary: 加拿大西捷航空於2026年7月30日發出封鎖通知，以回應加拿大公共員工協會8125分會提出的72小時罷工通知。若雙方未能在期限前達成協議，可能於2026年8月2日凌晨後發生停工。航空公司與工會均表示正全天候進行談判，西捷航空並針對7月30日至8月4日期間預訂機票的旅客提供彈性改退票政策。
body: 加拿大西捷航空於2026年7月30日正式發出封鎖通知，以回應加拿大公共員工協會（CUPE）8125分會先前所發出的72小時罷工通知。這項封鎖通知將阻止工會會員進入工作崗位。若勞資雙方無法在規定期限內達成團體協約，停工事件可能於2026年8月2日當地時間過後不久（即凌晨時分）正式發生。

西捷航空集團執行長 Alexis von Hoensbroech 對於封鎖通知造成的困擾與不確定性表示遺憾，並強調航空公司的承諾依然在談判桌上。他指出，西捷航空將每天24小時持續進行協商，致力於達成一份能為空服員帶來實質改善且符合公司永續發展的協議。同時，CUPE 8125 分會主席 Alia Hussain 表示，發出罷工通知並不意味著空服員渴望發動罷工行動，雙方仍有時間避免罷工發生，工會也將全天候繼續進行談判以解決問題。
此外，代表西捷航空空服員的工會 CUPE 8125 特別呼籲加拿大政府不要介入這起勞資爭議。工會要求政府尊重團體協商程序，讓勞資雙方能透過自主談判，最終達成一項公平且具可行性的合約協議。
針對可能面臨的航班影響，西捷航空說明發出通知並不代表會立即影響航班營運或必定發生勞資衝突。航空公司表示，針對預訂於2026年7月30日至8月4日期間出行的旅客，將繼續提供彈性的改票與退票政策，以利有需要的旅客提前安排替代行程。

en.title: WestJet Issues Lockout Notice Following Cabin Crew Strike Threat
en.summary: Canadian carrier WestJet issued a lockout notice on July 30, 2026, responding to a 72-hour strike notice by CUPE 8125 representing flight attendants. If no agreement is reached, a work stoppage could begin just after midnight on August 2, 2026. Both the airline and the union stated they are bargaining around the clock to reach a deal. WestJet has offered flexible booking change and cancellation policies for passengers traveling between July 30 and August 4, 2026.
body: Canadian air carrier WestJet issued a lockout notice on July 30, 2026, following a 72-hour strike notice announced by members of the Canadian Union of Public Employees (CUPE) 8125. The lockout notice is designed to prevent unionized employees from working if the dispute escalates. If the parties fail to reach an agreement before the deadline, a potential work stoppage could begin just after midnight, local time, on August 2, 2026.

Alexis von Hoensbroech, Chief Executive Officer of the WestJet Group, expressed regret over the uncertainty caused to guests and stated that the airline’s commitment remains firmly at the bargaining table. He noted that the company is willing to work 24 hours a day to secure a contract that provides meaningful improvements for cabin crew while remaining sustainable for the airline. Meanwhile, CUPE 8125 President Alia Hussain emphasized that the strike notice does not automatically mean cabin crew wish to commence industrial action, adding that time remains to prevent a strike as the union continues round-the-clock negotiations.

Additionally, CUPE 8125 has publicly requested that the Canadian government refrain from intervening in the ongoing dispute. The union urged authorities to respect the collective bargaining process and allow both parties to independently negotiate a fair agreement at the bargaining table.

Regarding potential operational impacts, WestJet clarified that the notices do not immediately disrupt flight operations or guarantee that labor action will occur. The airline confirmed that it will continue offering flexible change and cancellation policies for passengers holding travel bookings between July 30, 2026, and August 4, 2026, who wish to adjust their travel arrangements.

zh.title: Diehl Aviation於羅馬尼亞克拉約瓦啟用新民航元件工廠
zh.summary: 航空系統供應商 Diehl Aviation 在羅馬尼亞克拉約瓦啟用全新飛機元件生產設施，拓展其歐洲製造網路。該廠廠房與辦公空間超過 12,000 平方公尺，預計於 2026 年秋季開始投產，初期規劃約 75 名員工，中期預計擴增至 500 人，將生產客艙複合材料元件、隔熱毯以及水與廢水系統箱體。
body: 德商第一級航空系統供應商 Diehl Aviation 於羅馬尼亞克拉約瓦正式啟用全新飛機元件生產設施，為該公司在歐洲的商用飛機元件製造網路增設全新營運據點。此項建廠專案係與合作夥伴 Global Vision 合作開發完成，旨在擴充其整體製造產能，並支援全球客戶的生產提升需求。
新建生產基地位於羅馬尼亞多爾日地區，佔地面積達 33,500 平方公尺，其中包含超過 12,000 平方公尺的生產與辦公空間。該設施的建設過程耗時不到一年時間， Diehl Aviation 將此專案背後的投資規模描述為中等雙位數百萬歐元金額，但未透露具體的確切金額數字。
根據營運規劃，克拉約瓦工廠預計於 2026 年秋季正式展開生產作業，初期將配置約 75 名員工。公司計劃在中期階段將團隊人力逐漸擴充至最多 500 人，且該廠房區域在最初設計時即已預留空間，以便未來如有需求時可進行進一步的擴建。
在產線配置方面，該廠將首先投入生產 Diehl Aviation 網路中既有的成熟產品，包括手動層壓客艙複合材料元件、隔熱毯以及用於飛機水與廢水系統的儲水箱。為維護一致的品質標準，公司自 2026 年 2 月起即已展開員工在航空製造、品質管理與安全規範方面的專業培訓。
在能源與基礎設施設計上，該建築與生產設備完全依靠電力運行，成功自場區能源結構中完全排除天然氣。此外，廠區目前正在安裝屋頂太陽能發電系統，以提高再生能源的使用比例。新廠啟用後，將與 Diehl Aviation 位於德國、匈牙利及墨西哥的既有據點共同構成更完整的多國製造網路。

en.title: Diehl Aviation Opens New Commercial Aircraft Component Facility in Craiova, Romania
en.summary: Tier-1 supplier Diehl Aviation has opened a new commercial aircraft component production facility in Craiova, Romania, expanding its manufacturing footprint in Europe. Spanning over 12,000 square meters of production and office space on a 33,500-square-meter plot, the new site represents a mid-double-digit million euro investment. Production is scheduled to begin in fall 2026 with approximately 75 employees, with plans to expand the workforce up to 500 over the medium term. The plant will produce composite cabin components, insulation blankets, and water and waste system tanks.
body: Tier-1 aerospace supplier Diehl Aviation has officially opened a new aircraft component production facility in Craiova, Romania, adding another site to its European manufacturing network for commercial aviation components. Developed in cooperation with project partner Global Vision, the new site is designed to expand the company's overall manufacturing capacity and support customer production ramp-ups across its global network.

Located in Romania's Dolj region, the facility encompasses over 12,000 square meters of production and office space built on a 33,500-square-meter plot. Constructed in less than a year, Diehl Aviation described the project's financial backing as a mid-double-digit million euro investment, without disclosing an exact figure.

Production at the Craiova site is scheduled to commence in fall 2026, starting with an initial workforce of approximately 75 employees. Diehl Aviation plans to progressively scale up the facility's workforce to as many as 500 personnel over the medium term, with the site specifically designed with extra space to accommodate potential future operational expansion.

The Craiova plant will manufacture products already established within Diehl Aviation's network, including manually laminated composite cabin components, insulation blankets, and tanks for aircraft water and waste systems. To maintain consistent quality standards and transfer technical know-how from existing operations, employee training in aerospace manufacturing, quality management, and safety requirements began in February 2026 ahead of the opening.

In terms of sustainability and energy infrastructure, the building and its manufacturing equipment run entirely on electricity, completely eliminating natural gas from the site's energy mix. A rooftop solar system is currently being installed to further increase the share of renewable electricity used at the facility. The new Romanian site joins Diehl Aviation's active production operations in Germany, Hungary, and Mexico.
